lab_data.scope: Standalone actual-matrix kernels; not a complete solver speedup. CUDA events, 5 rounds, median. Matrix packing timed separately. CSR reference uses at least 64 mantissa bits; scalar units use 113 bits.

run_definition.baseline: same device thermo/GPU limiter, FP64 multicolor temperature increment
run_definition.ir_control: fp64 uses exactly the same inner Jacobi/refinement algorithm as fp32/ds/ts
run_definition.timing_policy: drop first two and last write step; rotate mode order per repeat
